title: An energy-based discontinuous Galerkin method for wave equations on complex geometric domains
summary: This paper develops a high-order cut energy-based discontinuous Galerkin (CutEDG) method for second-order acoustic wave equations on complex domains and across stationary material interfaces. The method employs unfitted Carte- sian meshes and addresses the small-cut-cell problem by introducing ghost-penalty stabilization directly into the local bilinear forms defining the EDG energy, while leaving the original spatial coupling and numerical-flux structure unchanged.
